data.name: Suvam
data.gender_notes: Suvam is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is pure, virtuous, and good. A person who embodies the qualities of truth, knowledge, and morality. Suvam is a name that signifies the highest ideals of Hindu spirituality. The name Suvam carries the meaning “Pure, Good, Clear” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Suvam usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, good, clear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Suvam is a name that represents the divine qualities of purity, truth, and morality. It is a name that is often used in Hindu spiritual practices and rituals to invoke the blessings of the gods and goddesses.
data.etymology: Suvam belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Good, Clear.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Suvam total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

Suvam is a name that is often given to babies as a reminder of the importance of living a good and virtuous life. It is also a name that may be used to address elders or respected individuals as a sign of respect and admiration for their moral character.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Suvam has deep significance. It signifies the aspirant's desire to live in accordance with the highest moral and ethical principles. Suvam is a reminder of the importance of truth, knowledge, and morality in attaining spiritual growth and enlightenment.
